description: Vicmap Land Administration Themes - Government Road Polygon is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. Part of the VLAT dataset series. This dataset supports the management of Victoria's Crown land. It is being created (June 2003 - Feb 2004) from migrating LCMP layers into the Vicmap structure. At this stage it does not cover Metropolitan Melbourne. The layer provides information about Crown Roads. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . Its tags are Environment, Society. It offers 7 resource(s) in DWG, DXF, EXTENDED TAB, GDB, MIF. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
